context:
Bounded Context: **Admin / Operations (운영자 콘솔)** of the Dibs platform.

Owns: partner approval lifecycle, account moderation/suspension, venue & event moderation (force-close / force-cancel / hide), platform-wide broadcasts (in-app 쪽지 + Resend email), operational dashboards, master data (categories / regions), platform fee & settlement scaffolding (data placeholders only, no PG execution), platform settings & feature flags, and an append-only audit log covering **both admin actions and partner override actions** (notably the partner's post-deadline final-list edit, which is the single biggest integrity risk in the BID mode).

Does NOT own (consumes via shared enums/IDs only): Account/Auth creation (Identity context — Google OAuth + JWT), Event authoring & application/bid mechanics (Event context), Deposit hold state machine (Payment context), notification rendering/delivery primitives (Notification context — Admin only *composes and targets*).

Stack assumptions honored: Prisma + Vercel Postgres (Neon), NestJS serverless on Vercel (no long-running process, no WebSocket, ~60s function ceiling), Vercel Cron for sweepers/workers, Vercel Blob for uploaded business documents, Resend for email, Next.js 15 App Router admin console at `apps/web/app/(admin)`.

Cross-cutting invariants adopted by this context:
- All timestamps are `DateTime @db.Timestamptz(6)`, stored UTC, generated by **DB `now()`** (never instance clock — multiple serverless instances skew). All display and all date bucketing use `Asia/Seoul` (no DST, fixed +09:00).
- Every admin mutation is idempotent via an `Idempotency-Key` header and optimistically concurrent via `expectedVersion`.
- Overbooking is acceptable platform-wide, so admin tooling never introduces distributed locks; it uses single conditional UPDATEs and `pg_try_advisory_lock` only for cron singleton-ness.
- MVP flags: `DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED=false`, `SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=false`, `IMPERSONATION_ENABLED=false`. Tables/state exist; execution paths are no-ops that still write audit + intent rows.
summary: Implementation-ready design for the Dibs Admin/Operations bounded context: 15 Prisma entities (partner approval, account suspension, moderation cases, admin-forced event actions, broadcast campaigns + per-recipient fan-out, category/region master data, versioned fee policy + settlement placeholders, platform settings/flags, and a hash-chained append-only audit log), 18 enums, ~50 REST endpoints under /admin, 6 state machines, 40+ concrete business rules, 45 adversarial edge cases (KST bucketing, cron overlap, force-close vs soft-close race, force-cancel vs partner finalize race, bid-amount leakage through broadcast templates, 사업자등록번호 abuse, audit tampering), Korean UX vocabulary, and open questions requiring a human decision.

entities.name: AdminProfile
entities.description: Elevated-privilege extension of a shared Account. Admin accounts are seeded or invited only — never self-signup. One row per admin Account.

fields.name: accountId
fields.notes: FK -> Account.id (Identity context). Account.role MUST be AccountRole.ADMIN; enforced in app layer + a CHECK-equivalent trigger is optional.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: SUPER_ADMIN | OPERATOR | SUPPORT | READ_ONLY. Coarse RBAC; permissions[] refines it.

fields.name: permissions
fields.notes: Prisma enum array. Additive grants on top of level. Empty = level defaults. Effective permission = levelDefaults(level) ∪ permissions.

fields.name: displayName
fields.notes: Shown in audit log and in 쪽지 sender line as '딥스 운영팀' by default; real name only inside the console.

fields.name: invitedByAdminId
fields.notes: Self-relation. Null for the bootstrap seed admin.

fields.name: activatedAt
fields.notes: Set on first successful Google login matching the invited email.

fields.name: isActive
fields.notes: Soft-disable. At least one ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN must always exist (guarded).

fields.name: twoPersonRuleExempt
fields.notes: If dual-approval is enabled for destructive ops, this bypasses it (bootstrap only).

fields.name: version
fields.notes: Optimistic concurrency.

entities.name: PartnerApplication
entities.description: 파트너 입점 신청. A Partner Account cannot operate (create venues/events) until an APPROVED application exists. Supports resubmission and later revocation.

fields.name: accountId
fields.notes: FK -> Account.id. NOT unique: resubmissions create new rows. Partial unique index enforces at most one non-terminal row per account (see business rules).

fields.name: partnerProfileId
fields.notes: FK -> PartnerProfile.id (Partner context), populated on approval.

fields.name: attemptNo
fields.notes: 1-based; increments per resubmission by the same account.

fields.name: businessName
fields.notes: 상호명. Trimmed, NFC-normalized, 1..100 chars.

fields.name: businessRegistrationNumber
fields.notes: 사업자등록번호, 10 digits, stored digits-only. Validated with the Korean mod-11 checksum. Encrypted at rest (pgcrypto or app-level AES-GCM); list views show masked 123-45-*****.

fields.name: brnHash
fields.notes: SHA-256(pepper + BRN). Unique partial index WHERE status = 'APPROVED' — prevents two live partners on one BRN while allowing rejected duplicates.

fields.name: representativeName
fields.notes: 대표자명. Personal data — redacted in audit diffs.

fields.name: contactPhone
fields.notes: E.164-normalized (+82...). Masked in non-detail views.

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.notes: May differ from the Google login email.

fields.name: regionId
fields.notes: FK -> Region.id (leaf/level-2). Used for region-segmented broadcasts and search.

fields.name: categoryIds
fields.notes: FK-ish array -> Category.id. Validated against active categories at submit time.

fields.name: documentBlobKeys
fields.notes: [{ kind: 'BUSINESS_LICENSE'|'ID_CARD'|'BANK_BOOK'|'OTHER', blobKey, mimeType, byteSize, uploadedAt }]. Vercel Blob keys stored PRIVATE; the console fetches short-TTL signed URLs from an admin-only endpoint.

fields.name: reviewStartedAt
fields.notes: Set when an admin claims the case (soft lock).

fields.name: reviewClaimedByAdminId
fields.notes: Soft assignment; auto-released after 30 min of inactivity by the sweeper.

fields.name: rejectionMemo
fields.notes: Sent verbatim to the applicant. Max 1000 chars. Required when reason = OTHER.

fields.name: internalMemo
fields.notes: Never exposed to the partner. Separate field on purpose.

fields.name: resubmitAllowedAfter
fields.notes: Cooldown gate for the next attempt (default decidedAt + 24h).

relations: PartnerApplication 1—N PartnerApplicationReview (event trail per decision step)

entities.name: PartnerApplicationReview
entities.description: Append-only per-step review trail (claim, request-more-info, approve, reject, revoke). Keeps PartnerApplication.status derivable and gives an SLA timeline.

entities.name: AccountSuspension
entities.description: 이용 제한. Time-boxed or indefinite restriction applied to a USER or PARTNER account. Multiple historical rows; at most one ACTIVE per (accountId, scope).

fields.name: targetRole
fields.notes: Snapshot of the role at issue time (role can change later).

fields.name: scope
fields.notes: FULL_LOGIN | APPLY_ONLY | BID_ONLY | EVENT_CREATE_ONLY | MESSAGING_ONLY. Granular so we can stop abuse without nuking the account.

fields.name: reasonMemo
fields.notes: Required, min 10 chars. Shown to the user in friendly Korean if userVisible = true.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.notes: NULL = indefinite (영구 제한). Enforcement is lazy-on-read + nightly cron flip.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: ACTIVE | EXPIRED | LIFTED

fields.name: cascadeAction
fields.notes: NONE | SUSPEND_OPEN_EVENTS | CANCEL_OPEN_EVENTS. Recorded so the effect is auditable and reversible-ish.

fields.name: affectedEventIds
fields.notes: Snapshot of events touched by the cascade, for undo/report.

entities.name: ModerationCase
entities.description: 신고/모니터링 건. Created by user reports, partner reports, admin spot-checks, or automated keyword flags (e.g. a partner broadcast containing 순위/커트라인 during an OPEN bid).

fields.name: targetType
fields.notes: VENUE | EVENT | ACCOUNT | BROADCAST_MESSAGE | DIRECT_MESSAGE | IMAGE | APPLICATION_NOTE

fields.name: targetId
fields.notes: Polymorphic id. Composite index (targetType, targetId, status).

fields.name: targetOwnerAccountId
fields.notes: Denormalized for 'repeat offender' aggregation.

fields.name: source
fields.notes: USER_REPORT | PARTNER_REPORT | ADMIN_PATROL | AUTO_KEYWORD | AUTO_RATE_LIMIT

fields.name: reporterAccountId
fields.notes: Null for AUTO_*/ADMIN_PATROL. Never disclosed to the target.

fields.name: reasonMemo
fields.notes: Max 1000 chars.

fields.name: evidenceSnapshot
fields.notes: Frozen copy of the offending content at report time (text, image blobKeys, event fields). Content can be edited/deleted afterward — this is the proof.

fields.name: severity
fields.notes: LOW | NORMAL | HIGH | CRITICAL. CRITICAL (사기/불법) auto-pages the on-call channel and auto-hides the target pending review.

fields.name: dedupeKey
fields.notes: hash(targetType|targetId|reporterAccountId|reasonCode|kstDate). Unique — one report per user per target per reason per KST day.

fields.name: duplicateCount
fields.notes: Incremented instead of inserting when a *different* reporter files the same reason; drives severity escalation.

entities.name: AdminEventAction
entities.description: Record of an admin overriding an event's lifecycle: force-close (강제 마감), force-cancel (강제 취소), unpublish/hide (노출 중지), restore, or extend deadline. Separate from AuditLog because it carries operational payload (refund intents, notification fan-out, snapshots) and must be queryable per event.

fields.name: eventId
fields.notes: FK -> Event.id (Event context).

fields.name: partnerProfileId
fields.notes: Denormalized owner for dashboards.

fields.name: eventModeSnapshot
fields.notes: INSTANT | BID at the time of action.

fields.name: closeMode
fields.notes: Only for FORCE_CLOSE. HONOR_DEPOSIT_WINDOW (default: applications stop, deposit windows keep running, ranking finalizes at now + maxRemainingDepositWindow) | TERMINATE_DEPOSIT_WINDOW (unpaid holds expire immediately).

fields.name: disabledSoftClose
fields.notes: Force-close ALWAYS sets event.softCloseEnabled=false in the same transaction, otherwise a bid landing 1ms later re-extends the deadline.

fields.name: newDeadlineAt
fields.notes: For EXTEND_DEADLINE.

fields.name: reasonMemo
fields.notes: Required, min 10 chars. Included in the 쪽지 sent to applicants when notifyApplicants = true.

fields.name: broadcastCampaignId
fields.notes: The auto-created campaign used to notify affected applicants.

fields.name: refundIntentCount
fields.notes: Number of DepositRefundIntent rows created (0 while DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED=false, but the code path runs).

fields.name: rankingSnapshot
fields.notes: For BID force-close: frozen [{applicationId, accountId, amount, lastBidAt, rank}] taken inside the closing transaction. This is the leak-proof source of truth for later disputes; never exposed to USER role.

entities.name: BroadcastCampaign
entities.description: 운영자 공지 / 파트너 알림 발송. One campaign = one composed message + one audience definition + fan-out to BroadcastRecipient rows. Used by admin (platform-wide segments) and by partners (applicants of their own event only).

fields.name: createdByAccountId
fields.notes: Admin or Partner account.

fields.name: createdByRole
fields.notes: ADMIN or PARTNER. Governs which segment types and which template variables are legal.

fields.name: scope
fields.notes: PLATFORM (admin only) | EVENT (partner or admin, bound to one event) | SYSTEM (auto-generated by AdminEventAction / suspension cascades).

fields.name: eventId
fields.notes: Required when scope = EVENT.

fields.name: channel
fields.notes: IN_APP | EMAIL | BOTH.

fields.name: segmentFilter
fields.notes: Validated by a zod schema in packages/shared per segmentType. e.g. { regionIds: [], categoryIds: [], applicationStatuses: ['CONFIRMED'], lastActiveWithinDays: 30 }. NO raw SQL ever.

fields.name: title
fields.notes: 1..60 chars. In-app 쪽지 title and email subject.

fields.name: bodyMarkdown
fields.notes: 1..4000 chars. Restricted markdown subset (bold, list, link). Sanitized server-side; links rewritten through a redirect+scan endpoint.

fields.name: templateVariables
fields.notes: Whitelisted variable names actually used, e.g. ['nickname','eventTitle','deadlineAtKst']. Validated against an allowlist that DEPENDS ON ROLE + EVENT STATE (see business rules — this is the bid-leak defense).

fields.name: scheduledAt
fields.notes: UTC. Console composes in KST and converts. Min +5 min from now so it can be canceled.

fields.name: audienceSnapshotAt
fields.notes: When recipient rows were materialized. Audience is FROZEN at this moment; later signups are not included.

fields.name: suppressedCount
fields.notes: Opt-out / bounced / suspended-account recipients skipped.

fields.name: cursor
fields.notes: Last processed BroadcastRecipient.id — lets the 60s-capped cron worker resume.

fields.name: requiresApproval
fields.notes: True when totalRecipients > BROADCAST_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD (default 5000) or createdByRole = PARTNER and auto-flagged.

fields.name: moderationCaseId
fields.notes: Set when auto-keyword flagging opened a case.

entities.name: BroadcastRecipient
entities.description: Materialized per-recipient fan-out row. Exists so delivery is resumable, idempotent, and reportable under a 60-second serverless ceiling.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: Use a monotonic id (cuid2 is fine with an ordered index on (campaignId, id)) so cursor paging is stable.

fields.name: emailSnapshot
fields.notes: Email frozen at snapshot time; account may change it mid-send.

fields.name: resendMessageId
fields.notes: For webhook correlation.

fields.name: notificationId
fields.notes: FK -> Notification.id created in the Notification context (쪽지).

fields.name: lastError
fields.notes: Truncated to 500 chars.

fields.name: suppressedReason
fields.notes: OPT_OUT | BOUNCED | ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED | ACCOUNT_WITHDRAWN | NO_EMAIL | DUPLICATE

entities.name: EmailSuppression
entities.description: Platform-wide email suppression list fed by Resend bounce/complaint webhooks and by user opt-out. Consulted before every email send.

fields.name: emailHash
fields.notes: SHA-256(lowercased email + pepper). Avoids storing a second plaintext copy.

fields.name: bounceCount
fields.notes: Hard bounce → suppress immediately; soft bounce → suppress at 3 within 30 days.

fields.name: releasedAt
fields.notes: Admin can manually release after the user fixes their address.

entities.name: AuditLog
entities.description: Append-only, tamper-evident record of every privileged action by ADMIN **and** every override action by PARTNER (final-list edits, manual selection overrides, deadline extensions). No UPDATE, no DELETE — enforced by a DB role that lacks those grants on this table plus a BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger that RAISEs.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: Sequential — the hash chain depends on total order per shard.

fields.name: actorAccountId
fields.notes: Null only for SYSTEM actions (cron sweepers).

fields.name: actorRole
fields.notes: Model as enum AuditActorRole { USER PARTNER ADMIN SYSTEM }.

fields.name: actorLabel
fields.notes: Denormalized display name at action time — accounts get renamed/deleted.

fields.name: impersonatedAccountId
fields.notes: Set when an admin acted through '파트너 대행 보기'. Non-null here is always a red flag in reviews.

fields.name: action
fields.notes: Enum, not free text — makes filtering and alerting reliable.

fields.name: summary
fields.notes: Human-readable one-liner rendered at write time in Korean, e.g. '이벤트 「금요일 오마카세」를 강제 마감했습니다.' Survives schema drift.

fields.name: beforeJson
fields.notes: Redacted diff of changed fields only (not whole rows). Redaction list: BRN, phone, email, tokens, blob signed URLs.

fields.name: reasonMemo
fields.notes: REQUIRED (min 10 chars) for every destructive action — enforced at the service layer, not just the UI.

fields.name: requestId
fields.notes: Vercel request id / x-vercel-id. Correlates with runtime logs.

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.notes: From x-forwarded-for, first hop. Truncate IPv4 to /24 and IPv6 to /48 after 90 days (개인정보 최소수집).

fields.name: userAgent
fields.notes: Truncated to 300 chars.

fields.name: prevHash
fields.notes: Hash of the immediately preceding row in the same chain partition.

fields.name: rowHash
fields.notes: SHA-256(prevHash || id || actorAccountId || action || targetType || targetId || canonicalJson(before,after) || createdAtIso). Verified by a weekly cron; mismatch pages the team.

fields.name: chainKey
fields.notes: Partition key for the hash chain. Single writer per chain — serialize with a tiny advisory lock or an INSERT ... SELECT that reads the last row FOR UPDATE. Under admin-console write volumes (<< 10 tps) this is free.

relations: Indexes: (targetType, targetId, createdAt DESC), (actorAccountId, createdAt DESC), (action, createdAt DESC), (createdAt DESC)

entities.name: Category
entities.description: 업종/카테고리 master data (e.g. 오마카세, 파인다이닝, 루프탑바). Referenced by venues, events, search filters, and broadcast segments.

fields.name: slug
fields.notes: Immutable after creation (URLs and saved filters depend on it). Lowercase ASCII.

fields.name: nameKo
fields.notes: User-facing Korean name. Editable.

fields.name: parentId
fields.notes: Max depth 2. Self-relation.

fields.name: iconKey
fields.notes: Vercel Blob key or lucide icon name.

fields.name: isActive
fields.notes: Inactive = hidden from new authoring and from filter chips, but existing events keep rendering it.

fields.name: usageCount
fields.notes: Denormalized, refreshed nightly. Drives the 'cannot delete, merge instead' guard.

fields.name: mergedIntoCategoryId
fields.notes: Set when an admin merges this category into another; reads follow one hop.

relations: Category N—M Venue / Event (via Event context)

entities.name: Region
entities.description: 지역 master data mirroring Korean 행정구역: level 1 = 시/도 (17), level 2 = 시/군/구. Seeded from the official 행정표준코드, not hand-typed.

fields.name: code
fields.notes: 행정표준코드 (10-digit 법정동코드 prefix). Stable join key for future external data.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: 1 or 2.

fields.name: parentId
fields.notes: Null for level 1.

fields.name: nameKo
fields.notes: e.g. '서울특별시', '강남구'.

fields.name: shortNameKo
fields.notes: e.g. '서울', '강남'. Used in compact filter chips.

fields.name: centroidLat
fields.notes: Placeholder for future distance sort; no PostGIS in MVP.

entities.name: PlatformFeePolicy
entities.description: SCAFFOLDING ONLY (SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=false). Versioned, non-overlapping fee schedule. Snapshotted onto an event at publish time so a later policy change never retroactively alters money owed.

fields.name: name
fields.notes: e.g. '2026 표준 수수료'.

fields.name: appliesTo
fields.notes: GLOBAL | CATEGORY | REGION | PARTNER. Resolution order: PARTNER > CATEGORY > REGION > GLOBAL.

fields.name: scopeRefId
fields.notes: categoryId / regionId / partnerProfileId depending on appliesTo.

fields.name: eventMode
fields.notes: Null = both. Lets BID events carry a different rate than INSTANT.

fields.name: feeType
fields.notes: PERCENT | FIXED | HYBRID (percent + fixed floor/cap).

fields.name: percentBps
fields.notes: Basis points (e.g. 350 = 3.5%). Integer — never float money.

fields.name: fixedAmountKrw
fields.notes: KRW is integer-only; no minor units.

fields.name: vatIncluded
fields.notes: 부가세 포함 여부. Explicit because Korean settlement disputes are almost always about this.

fields.name: effectiveTo
fields.notes: Exclusive. Overlap prevented by a Postgres EXCLUDE constraint on (appliesTo, scopeRefId, eventMode, tstzrange(effectiveFrom, effectiveTo)) WITH =,=,=,&&.

entities.name: SettlementRecord
entities.description: SCAFFOLDING ONLY. One row per (event, partner) settlement cycle. Amounts are computed and stored but nothing is transferred while SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=false.

fields.name: periodKstDate
fields.notes: 'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD' in KST. Stored as text to make the KST bucketing explicit and non-ambiguous.

fields.name: confirmedCount
fields.notes: Final confirmed list size after partner edits.

fields.name: grossAmountKrw
fields.notes: Sum of confirmed applied amounts (BID) or capacity*price (INSTANT).

fields.name: depositCollectedKrw
fields.notes: 0 while DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED=false.

fields.name: feePolicySnapshot
fields.notes: Full frozen copy of the PlatformFeePolicy row used, including its id and version.

fields.name: netPayoutKrw
fields.notes: grossAmount - platformFee - vat (sign conventions documented in code).

fields.name: holdReason
fields.notes: e.g. open moderation case on this partner.

fields.name: payoutRefId
fields.notes: External PG/bank reference. Null in MVP.

entities.name: PlatformSetting
entities.description: Typed, auditable key/value store for operational knobs and feature flags. Read through a 60s-TTL in-memory cache per serverless instance, with an explicit cache-bust version counter.

fields.name: key
fields.notes: e.g. 'DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED', 'DEFAULT_DEPOSIT_WINDOW_MINUTES', 'SOFT_CLOSE_DEFAULT_MINUTES', 'BROADCAST_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD', 'PARTNER_BROADCAST_DAILY_LIMIT'.

fields.name: valueJson
fields.notes: Shape validated by a zod schema registered per key in packages/shared.

fields.name: valueType
fields.notes: BOOLEAN | INT | STRING | JSON | DURATION_MINUTES

fields.name: category
fields.notes: 'FEATURE_FLAG' | 'LIMITS' | 'CONTENT' | 'OPS'

fields.name: isDangerous
fields.notes: Requires SUPER_ADMIN + typed confirmation of the key name.

fields.name: revision
fields.notes: Bumped on every write; a global MAX(revision) is the cache-bust token.

entities.name: MetricDailySnapshot
entities.description: Pre-aggregated dashboard rollups bucketed by KST date. Computed by a 00:10 KST cron so the dashboard never runs heavy scans on a serverless request.

fields.name: kstDate
fields.notes: 'YYYY-MM-DD' in Asia/Seoul. Computed as (createdAt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date — NEVER as UTC date.

fields.name: dimension
fields.notes: PLATFORM | REGION | CATEGORY | PARTNER | EVENT_MODE

fields.name: avgCompetitionRatioBps
fields.notes: Basis points to stay integral (4.7:1 → 47000).

enums.name: AccountStatus
enums.notes: Shared with Identity context; Admin context reads and drives transitions.

enums.name: EventStatus
enums.notes: Shared with Event context. Admin context can only drive OPEN→CLOSED/SUSPENDED/CANCELED, SUSPENDED→OPEN, and *→CANCELED.

enums.name: EventVisibilityLevel
enums.notes: Owned by Event context; Admin can override per event and set the platform default. MVP forces RATIO_ONLY.

endpoints.description: 현재 운영자 프로필 + 유효 권한 집합 + 위험 작업에 필요한 재인증 여부 반환.
이메일로 운영자 초대. Creates Account(role=ADMIN, status=PENDING_ACTIVATION) + AdminProfile. Google 로그인 이메일이 일치해야 활성화.
운영자 목록 (level, permissions, lastLoginAt, isActive).
level/permissions/isActive 변경. Blocks self-demotion and blocks deactivating the last ACTIVE SUPER_ADMIN.
입점 신청 목록. Filters: status, regionId, categoryId, submittedFrom/To (KST dates), q (상호명/대표자/BRN 마스킹 검색), slaBreached=true. Sort: submittedAt asc (oldest first, SLA-driven).
신청 상세 + 심사 이력 + 동일 BRN/전화/이메일 계정 중복 경고 + 신청자의 기존 제재 이력.
심사 착수(소프트 락). Conditional UPDATE ... WHERE reviewClaimedByAdminId IS NULL OR reviewStartedAt < now()-30min. 409 if already claimed.
승인. Tx: application→APPROVED, create/activate PartnerProfile, Account.partnerApproved=true, audit, enqueue SYSTEM broadcast '입점 승인'. Requires Idempotency-Key + expectedVersion.
반려. Body: reasonCode, rejectionMemo, resubmitCooldownHours(default 24). Sends 쪽지+이메일 with the memo verbatim.
보완 요청. status→MORE_INFO_REQUIRED, partner can edit the same row and resubmit without incrementing attemptNo.
Vercel Blob 비공개 문서의 90초 TTL 서명 URL 발급. Every issuance writes an audit row (문서 열람 기록).
입점 취소. Body: reason, cascade(NONE|SUSPEND_OPEN_EVENTS|CANCEL_OPEN_EVENTS). Returns a dry-run preview when ?dryRun=true (affected event/applicant counts).
입점 재개.
계정 검색. Filters: role, status, regionId, joinedFrom/To(KST), hasActiveSuspension, q(닉네임/이메일 부분일치). Email shown masked unless permission ACCOUNT_SUSPEND.
계정 상세: 프로필, 제재 이력, 신고 이력(가해/피해), 최근 신청/입찰 요약(금액은 종료된 이벤트만 노출), 로그인 이력.
이용 제한 부과. Body: scope, reasonCode, reasonMemo(min 10), endsAt|null, userVisible, cascadeAction. Idempotent by key. 409 if an ACTIVE suspension with the same scope exists.
제한 해제. Body: liftReason (required).
제재 이력 전체.
탈퇴/개인정보 파기 처리. Pseudonymizes PII, keeps aggregate rows and audit references by accountId hash. Irreversible — requires typed confirmation of the nickname.
신고 큐. Filters: status, severity, targetType, source, assignedAdminId, reasonCode, createdFrom/To(KST). Default sort: severity desc, createdAt asc.
신고 상세 + evidenceSnapshot + 대상의 다른 신고 건 + 동일 대상 누적 카운트.
담당자 지정/자가 배정.
처리. Body: resolutionAction, resolutionMemo, notifyReporter, plus the action-specific payload (suspension params / event action params). Executes the action and the case update in ONE transaction.
기각. Body: memo, markReporterAbusive(bool) — repeated abusive reporting feeds a MESSAGING_ONLY suspension.

transitions: SUBMITTED → IN_REVIEW (admin claims; conditional UPDATE on reviewClaimedByAdminId IS NULL OR stale)
SUBMITTED|IN_REVIEW → MORE_INFO_REQUIRED (admin requests documents; applicant may edit the SAME row)
MORE_INFO_REQUIRED → SUBMITTED (applicant resubmits; attemptNo unchanged, reviewClaim cleared)
IN_REVIEW → APPROVED (creates/activates PartnerProfile, sets brnHash unique-live guard)
IN_REVIEW → REJECTED (reasonCode required; sets resubmitAllowedAfter = now + cooldown)
SUBMITTED|IN_REVIEW|MORE_INFO_REQUIRED → WITHDRAWN (applicant self-withdraws)
APPROVED → REVOKED (admin revokes; cascade decision required)
REVOKED → APPROVED (reinstate, SUPER_ADMIN only)
REJECTED → (terminal; a new application row with attemptNo+1 is created after cooldown)
IN_REVIEW → SUBMITTED (claim auto-released by cron after 30 min idle)
(none) → ACTIVE: admin issues; Account.status → SUSPENDED only when scope=FULL_LOGIN, otherwise Account.status stays ACTIVE and the scope is enforced per-endpoint
ACTIVE → EXPIRED: endsAt <= now(); by hourly cron AND lazily on any authenticated request (whichever fires first — never trust the cron alone)
ACTIVE → LIFTED: admin lifts with reason
EXPIRED|LIFTED → (terminal; a new suspension row is required to re-restrict)
Account.status recomputation rule: SUSPENDED iff EXISTS(suspension WHERE status=ACTIVE AND scope=FULL_LOGIN); computed inside the same transaction as any suspension write
OPEN → IN_REVIEW (assign)
OPEN|IN_REVIEW → ACTION_TAKEN (resolve with a non-NONE ModerationActionType; the action executes in the same tx)
OPEN|IN_REVIEW → DISMISSED (no violation found)
OPEN|IN_REVIEW → ESCALATED (legal/law-enforcement; freezes the target and blocks settlement)
OPEN → AUTO_CLOSED (target was deleted/canceled by its owner before review; evidenceSnapshot retained)
CRITICAL severity on create → target auto-hidden immediately, case stays OPEN with a 1-hour SLA
duplicateCount >= 5 distinct reporters within 24h KST → severity auto-escalates one level (max HIGH; CRITICAL is human-only)
OPEN → CLOSED (FORCE_CLOSE; sets softCloseEnabled=false in the same tx; BID snapshots ranking)
OPEN → SUSPENDED (UNPUBLISH; hidden from discovery, new applications rejected with 409 EVENT_NOT_ACCEPTING, existing applications and holds untouched)
SUSPENDED → OPEN (RESTORE; only if deadlineAt > now(), else 422 requiring EXTEND_DEADLINE first)
OPEN|SUSPENDED|CLOSED|FINALIZING → CANCELED (FORCE_CANCEL; terminal, always wins races)
FINALIZED → CANCELED (allowed but requires SUPER_ADMIN + an open ModerationCase; triggers refund intents for confirmed applicants)
FINALIZED → FINALIZING (RESET_FINAL_LIST; restores pure-ranking selection, SUPER_ADMIN + ModerationCase required)
CANCELED → (terminal, no path back — a re-run is a new event)
Guard: every admin transition is `UPDATE event SET ... WHERE id=? AND status=? AND version=?` returning rowCount; rowCount=0 → 409 with the current status
DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL (preview count > threshold, or auto-keyword flag, or partner-authored platform-adjacent content)
DRAFT|PENDING_APPROVAL → SCHEDULED (scheduledAt >= now+5min)
PENDING_APPROVAL → DRAFT (approver rejects with memo)
DRAFT|SCHEDULED → SNAPSHOTTING (send trigger; audience is materialized into BroadcastRecipient rows in chunks, audienceSnapshotAt set)
SNAPSHOTTING → SENDING (all recipient rows written, totalRecipients frozen)
SENDING → SENT (all recipients terminal, failedCount = 0)
SENDING → PARTIALLY_FAILED (all recipients terminal, failedCount > 0; retryable via a targeted retry endpoint)
SNAPSHOTTING|SENDING → CANCELED (stops the worker at the next cursor checkpoint; already-delivered messages are NOT recalled and the API says so)
SNAPSHOTTING → FAILED (segment resolution error, e.g. the referenced event was deleted)

Worker contract: each cron tick claims the campaign with `UPDATE ... SET lockedUntil = now()+90s WHERE (lockedUntil IS NULL OR lockedUntil < now())` so two overlapping crons never double-send; per-recipient idempotence is guaranteed by @@unique([campaignId, accountId]) plus a per-row status check
DRAFT → COMPUTED (recompute job fills amounts from the frozen feePolicySnapshot)
COMPUTED → READY (admin confirms; blocked while the partner has an OPEN/ESCALATED ModerationCase or an ACTIVE suspension)
COMPUTED|READY → ON_HOLD (dispute/hold with reason)
ON_HOLD → READY (hold released)
READY → PAID (SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=true only; MVP returns 501 Not Implemented)
any → CANCELED (event force-canceled)

businessRules: **BR-A1 (권한 모델)**: Effective permissions = levelDefaults(level) ∪ AdminProfile.permissions. Defaults: SUPER_ADMIN = all; OPERATOR = PARTNER_APPROVE, ACCOUNT_SUSPEND, MODERATION_RESOLVE, EVENT_FORCE_CLOSE, EVENT_UNPUBLISH, BROADCAST_SEND, MASTERDATA_WRITE; SUPPORT = read + BROADCAST_SEND(EVENT scope only) + MODERATION_RESOLVE(dismiss only); READ_ONLY = read only. EVENT_FORCE_CANCEL, ACCOUNT_DELETE, FEE_POLICY_WRITE, SETTINGS_WRITE(dangerous), IMPERSONATE, ADMIN_MANAGE are never in a default set — always explicit grants.

**BR-A2 (최소 1인 슈퍼관리자)**: Any write that would leave zero rows matching (level=SUPER_ADMIN AND isActive=true) is rejected with 422 LAST_SUPER_ADMIN. Enforced with `SELECT count(*) ... FOR UPDATE` inside the same transaction, not a pre-check.
**BR-A3 (자가 권한 변경 금지)**: An admin cannot modify their own level, permissions, or isActive. Prevents both accidental lockout and quiet privilege escalation.

**BR-A4 (운영자 가입 불가)**: Google OAuth callback assigns role ADMIN only when a matching AdminProfile with invitedAt != null and activatedAt == null exists for that exact email. Otherwise the account is created as USER. There is no self-service admin signup path, ever.

**BR-A5 (파괴적 작업 사유 필수)**: reasonMemo with >= 10 non-whitespace chars is required for suspend, revoke, force-cancel, force-close, reset-final-list, anonymize, and dangerous setting changes. Validated in the service layer (zod in packages/shared), not only in the form.

**BR-A6 (재인증)**: Actions in the DANGEROUS set (force-cancel, anonymize, admin permission change, fee policy write, impersonate) require the JWT's `authTime` to be within 15 minutes; otherwise 401 REAUTH_REQUIRED and the console re-runs Google login.

**BR-A7 (멱등성)**: Every POST/PATCH under /admin requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (uuid v4). Stored in an `AdminIdempotency(key PK, adminId, endpoint, requestHash, responseJson, statusCode, createdAt)` table with a 24h TTL. A replay with the same key and same requestHash returns the stored response; same key with a different hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. This is the double-submit defense — not a UI disabled-button.

**BR-A8 (낙관적 동시성)**: Mutations on versioned rows require `expectedVersion`. Mismatch → 409 STALE_WRITE with the current row so the console can show a diff. No admin write ever uses read-modify-write without it.

**BR-P1 (사업자등록번호 검증)**: 10 digits, Korean mod-11 checksum (weights 1,3,7,1,3,7,1,3,5 with the 9th digit's tens carry). Failing the checksum is an inline validation error at submit time, not a rejection reason burned on an attempt.

**BR-P2 (BRN 중복)**: A unique index on brnHash WHERE status = 'APPROVED' guarantees at most one live partner per BRN. A second application on a live BRN is flagged DUPLICATE_BUSINESS in the review UI before an admin acts, and an approve attempt returns 409.
**BR-P3 (단일 진행중 신청)**: Partial unique index on (accountId) WHERE status IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW','MORE_INFO_REQUIRED'). Prevents a partner from flooding the queue with parallel applications.

**BR-P4 (재신청 쿨다운/한도)**: After REJECTED, the next attempt is blocked until resubmitAllowedAfter (default decidedAt + 24h). attemptNo > 5 requires an admin to explicitly unlock (a setting on the account), preventing brute-force resubmission.

**BR-P5 (승인 SLA)**: Target 1 business day (KST, excluding weekends and public holidays from a seeded holiday table). Applications past SLA are surfaced with a red badge and counted on the dashboard. SLA breach never auto-approves.

**BR-P6 (승인 전 운영 불가)**: PartnerProfile.canOperate = (application APPROVED) AND (no ACTIVE suspension with scope FULL_LOGIN or EVENT_CREATE_ONLY). Enforced by a NestJS guard on every partner write endpoint, not by hiding UI.

**BR-P7 (문서 접근 감사)**: Every signed-URL issuance for a business document writes an audit row. Signed URLs are 90-second TTL, single-use where the Blob API allows, and never logged in plaintext (only the blobKey is logged).

**BR-S1 (제재 스코프 우선순위)**: FULL_LOGIN implies all narrower scopes. Overlapping ACTIVE scopes are allowed; enforcement is the union. Issuing an identical (accountId, scope) while one is ACTIVE returns 409 — extend or lift the existing one instead.

**BR-S2 (지연 만료)**: Suspension expiry is evaluated lazily on every authenticated request (`endsAt <= now()` → treat as expired and flip in a fire-and-forget transaction) AND by hourly cron. The cron is a backstop, never the sole mechanism — a serverless cron can be delayed or skipped.

**BR-S3 (파트너 제재의 이벤트 파급)**: Suspending or revoking a partner NEVER silently cancels events. Default cascade = SUSPEND_OPEN_EVENTS: the events become SUSPENDED (hidden, no new applications), existing applicants are notified with a neutral message ('사정으로 신청이 일시 중단되었습니다'), and an admin must make an explicit cancel-or-resume decision within 72 hours (a dashboard countdown enforces this operationally).

**BR-S4 (제재 사유 공개)**: userVisible=true renders a friendly Korean reason to the suspended account. Even when false, the account is told that a restriction exists and how to appeal — silent restriction is prohibited.

**BR-M1 (신고 중복 제거)**: dedupeKey = hash(targetType|targetId|reporterAccountId|reasonCode|KST date). Same reporter, same target, same reason, same KST day → the insert is a no-op returning the existing case. Different reporters increment duplicateCount on the open case rather than creating N cases.
**BR-M2 (신고자 익명성)**: reporterAccountId is never returned by any endpoint reachable by PARTNER or USER, and is excluded from evidenceSnapshot rendering and from audit summaries.

**BR-M3 (자동 선차단)**: severity=CRITICAL (FRAUD_SCAM, ILLEGAL_ACTIVITY, ADULT_CONTENT) auto-hides the target (event → SUSPENDED, image → hidden) at case creation, before human review, and starts a 1-hour SLA. False positives are cheap to reverse; live fraud is not.

**BR-M4 (신고 남용)**: An account whose reports are DISMISSED with markReporterAbusive >= 3 times in 30 days receives an automatic 7-day MESSAGING_ONLY suspension, with the standard notification and appeal path.

**BR-M5 (경쟁 조작 신고)**: ReportReason.COMPETITION_MANIPULATION on a BID event routes to a dedicated queue and grants the reviewing admin the ranking snapshot view. Resolution options include RESET_FINAL_LIST.

**BR-E1 (강제 마감 원자성)**: FORCE_CLOSE runs as `UPDATE "Event" SET status='CLOSED', closedAt=now(), softCloseEnabled=false, version=version+1 WHERE id=$1 AND status='OPEN' AND version=$2`. rowCount=0 → 409. Setting softCloseEnabled=false in the same statement is mandatory: otherwise a bid committed microseconds later extends the deadline of an already-closed event.

**BR-E2 (강제 마감과 입금 창)**: HONOR_DEPOSIT_WINDOW (default) keeps outstanding deposit windows running and schedules ranking finalization at max(existing holdExpiresAt) — preserving the platform promise that a last-minute applicant gets a full window. TERMINATE_DEPOSIT_WINDOW expires all pending holds immediately and is allowed only with reasonCode in {FRAUD_SUSPECTED, LEGAL_REQUEST} — it takes money-adjacent rights away from users.

**BR-E3 (강제 취소가 항상 이긴다)**: CANCELED is terminal and unconditional except for status='CANCELED' itself. A concurrent partner finalize is rejected with 409 EVENT_CANCELED. Ordering is guaranteed by the row lock the UPDATE takes; no distributed lock is needed.

**BR-E4 (취소 시 환불 의도 생성)**: FORCE_CANCEL creates one DepositRefundIntent per application with a paid deposit, inside the cancel transaction, even while DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED=false (count will be 0). The code path must be exercised from day one so enabling the flag is not a rewrite.

**BR-E5 (마감 연장 제약)**: newDeadlineAt must satisfy now() < newDeadlineAt <= now() + 14 days, and must be later than the current deadlineAt (extension only, never shortening — shortening is FORCE_CLOSE). Every extension notifies all current applicants (deadline-extended trigger) to preserve fairness.

**BR-E6 (정원 수정)**: EDIT_CAPACITY may only INCREASE capacity for an OPEN INSTANT event (decreasing would retroactively invalidate confirmed slots). For BID events capacity may be changed in either direction before finalization, because BID capacity only matters at ranking time — but any decrease requires a reasonMemo and notifies applicants.

**BR-E7 (오버부킹 표시)**: The admin event list flags claimedCount > capacity as an informational badge (초과 확정), not an error. Slight overbooking is an accepted business outcome resolved on the partner's final-list screen; admin tooling must never auto-correct it.

**BR-E8 (파트너 오버라이드 감사)**: Every partner final-list edit writes AuditAction.PARTNER_FINAL_LIST_EDITED with beforeJson/afterJson = the applicationId sets and, when a lower-ranked applicant is selected over a higher-ranked one, AuditAction.PARTNER_SELECTION_OVERRIDE with the specific rank inversion. The admin dashboard surfaces a per-partner 'override rate'; > 30% inversions across 3+ events auto-opens a NORMAL ModerationCase.

**BR-B1 (대상자 스냅샷 고정)**: Recipients are materialized once at audienceSnapshotAt. Accounts created after that moment are never included, even if the send takes 20 minutes. This makes 'who got it' answerable and prevents an infinite audience during a signup spike.
**BR-B2 (수신자 중복 불가)**: @@unique([campaignId, accountId]). Overlapping segment filters (e.g. REGION ∪ CATEGORY_INTEREST) can never double-send.

**BR-B3 (발송 청크 예산)**: The cron worker processes recipients until 45 seconds of wall clock have elapsed, then persists `cursor` and returns 200. Vercel's 60s ceiling is never approached. Resend is called with the batch API at 100 recipients per request with a concurrency of 2.

**BR-B4 (템플릿 변수 화이트리스트 — 정보 유출 방어)**: Allowed variables depend on role AND event state. PARTNER, event OPEN: {nickname, eventTitle, deadlineAtKst, applicantCount, capacity, competitionRatio}. Explicitly FORBIDDEN in that state: {bidAmount, myRank, cutoffAmount, topAmount, minWinningAmount}. Those become available only after event.status ∈ {FINALIZED} and only to recipients whose application is CONFIRMED. Violations are rejected at compose time with 422 FORBIDDEN_TEMPLATE_VARIABLE.

**BR-B5 (본문 자동 검열)**: Partner-authored EVENT-scope broadcasts sent while the event is OPEN are scanned for a Korean keyword list (순위, 등수, 커트라인, 최고가, 1등, 상위, 낙찰가, 지금 얼마) plus any KRW-looking numeric token (\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+원|\d+만원). A hit sets requiresApproval=true and opens an AUTO_KEYWORD ModerationCase. It does not hard-block — a legitimate '10만원 상당 사은품' message should be reviewable, not impossible.

**BR-B6 (발송 한도)**: PLATFORM-scope broadcast: max 1 per hour and 3 per KST day platform-wide (a shared counter, not per admin). PARTNER EVENT-scope: max 3 per event per KST day and min 10 minutes between sends for the same event. Exceeded → 429 with the next allowed time in KST.
**BR-B7 (대량 발송 이중 승인)**: totalRecipients (from preview) > BROADCAST_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD (default 5000) forces PENDING_APPROVAL, and the approver must be a different AdminProfile than the creator.

**BR-B8 (수신 거부)**: Marketing-category broadcasts respect Account.marketingOptIn (정보통신망법 광고성 정보 수신동의) and are suppressed with reason OPT_OUT. Transactional/SYSTEM broadcasts (event canceled, deposit required, selected/not-selected, suspension notice) ignore opt-out — they are service notifications, not advertising. The category is an explicit field on compose; mislabeling is an audited act.

**BR-B9 (야간 발송 제한)**: Marketing-category broadcasts cannot be sent or scheduled between 21:00 and 08:00 KST (정보통신망법 야간 광고 전송 제한). Transactional broadcasts are exempt. The scheduler validates against the KST wall clock at both schedule time and execution time.

**BR-B10 (발송 취소의 정직함)**: Canceling a SENDING campaign stops future batches only. The API response returns { stopped: true, alreadyDelivered: N, notSent: M } and the UI states plainly that N messages cannot be recalled.

**BR-D1 (마스터데이터 삭제 금지)**: Categories and Regions are never hard-deleted. A category in use (usageCount > 0) can only be merged into another; an unused category can be deactivated. slug and Region.code are immutable after creation because saved search filters and shared URLs embed them.
**BR-D2 (지역 시드)**: Region rows are seeded from 행정표준코드 via a migration, not created by hand in the console. The console may only edit nameKo/shortNameKo/sortOrder/isActive.

**BR-F1 (수수료 정책 스냅샷)**: The applicable PlatformFeePolicy is resolved and copied into the event at publish time (and into SettlementRecord.feePolicySnapshot at compute time). A policy change never retroactively alters an already-published event's economics.
**BR-F2 (정책 기간 비중첩)**: Enforced by a Postgres EXCLUDE constraint, not application logic. Money rules must be enforced by the database.

**BR-F3 (정수 원화)**: All KRW amounts are Int (or BigInt for sums). No floats anywhere in the fee/settlement path. Percentages are basis points. Rounding is floor-to-won, documented once, applied in one helper in packages/shared.
**BR-F4 (정산 보류 조건)**: A SettlementRecord cannot leave ON_HOLD/COMPUTED for READY while the partner has an OPEN or ESCALATED ModerationCase or an ACTIVE suspension.

**BR-L1 (감사 로그 불변성)**: The application's DB role has INSERT and SELECT on "AuditLog" but not UPDATE or DELETE. A BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger RAISEs EXCEPTION as a second line of defense. Prisma's model is annotated and the service exposes only append().

**BR-L2 (감사 로그 필수 기록)**: Every endpoint under /admin that is not a pure GET writes exactly one AuditLog row inside the SAME transaction as the business change. If the audit insert fails, the business change rolls back. Auditing is not best-effort.

**BR-L3 (해시 체인)**: rowHash = sha256(prevHash ?? '' || id || actorAccountId ?? '' || action || targetType || targetId || canonicalJson({before, after}) || createdAt.toISOString()). The chain is verified weekly; a break raises a CRITICAL alert. Writers serialize on the chain tail via a short advisory lock — admin write volume makes this free.

**BR-L4 (감사 로그 PII)**: beforeJson/afterJson store only changed fields, with a redaction allowlist. BRN, phone, email, addresses, signed URLs, and tokens are replaced with '[REDACTED]' or a masked form. IP addresses are truncated (/24, /48) after 90 days by a monthly cron. Retention: 3 years, then hard delete of the row body with the hash chain preserved via a tombstone row.

**BR-L5 (대량 조회도 기록)**: Exporting audit logs, exporting applicant lists with amounts, and issuing document signed URLs are themselves audited. Read access to competitively sensitive data is an auditable event.

**BR-V1 (가시성 기본값)**: Platform default EventVisibilityLevel = RATIO_ONLY and PlatformSetting 'VISIBILITY_OVERRIDE_ALLOWED' = false in MVP. An admin can override a single event's visibility only when that setting is true; the toggle exists in the data model and the console from day one so loosening the product later is a config change, not a migration.

**BR-V2 (운영자/파트너 전체 열람)**: ADMIN sees all amounts and ranks for any event. PARTNER sees all amounts and ranks for their OWN events only, at any time (this is an explicit product decision, and every such view of an OPEN event is logged so we can detect a partner leaking cutoffs to a friend).

**BR-T1 (시간 규칙)**: Store UTC timestamptz, generate with DB now(). All date bucketing, daily limits, 'today' counters, and settlement periods use (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date. Never Date.now() on a serverless instance for anything that affects eligibility, ordering, or limits.

**BR-T2 (크론 단일 실행)**: Every cron endpoint verifies the x-vercel-cron header plus a shared secret, then takes pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext('cron:<name>')). Failure to acquire returns 200 immediately (another instance is running) — never 500, or Vercel will retry into a thundering herd.

**BR-T3 (크론은 백스톱일 뿐)**: Every time-based state change (hold expiry, suspension expiry, event auto-close, scheduled broadcast) has BOTH a cron path and a lazy-on-read path, both wrapped in DB transactions with conditional UPDATEs. A missed cron tick delays, but never breaks, correctness.
edgeCases: **동시 승인 (심사 경합)**: Two admins open the same PartnerApplication and both click 승인. Defense: `claim` soft lock + `expectedVersion` on approve + a conditional UPDATE `WHERE status IN ('SUBMITTED','IN_REVIEW')`. The loser gets 409 with the winner's decision rendered. The idempotency table prevents the loser's retry from creating a second PartnerProfile.

**더블 클릭 강제 취소**: Two identical FORCE_CANCEL requests. First succeeds; the second finds status='CANCELED' and, because it carries the same Idempotency-Key, returns the stored 200 response rather than a confusing 409. A *different* key with the same target returns 409 EVENT_ALREADY_CANCELED — and critically, does NOT create a second set of refund intents.

**강제 마감 vs 소프트 클로즈 (경합)**: A sniping bid commits at T, the admin's force-close commits at T+1ms. If softCloseEnabled were left true, a bid-triggered `deadlineAt = deadlineAt + N` update could resurrect a CLOSED event's deadline. Defense: force-close sets softCloseEnabled=false in the same UPDATE, and the soft-close extension statement is itself `UPDATE ... WHERE status='OPEN' AND softCloseEnabled=true`.

**무한 소프트 클로즈**: Colluding accounts raise by 1원 every N-1 minutes forever. Admin needs a hard ceiling: PlatformSetting SOFT_CLOSE_MAX_EXTENSIONS (default 20) and SOFT_CLOSE_ABSOLUTE_DEADLINE (original deadline + 6h). The admin console shows extension count; an event hitting the ceiling raises a dashboard alert and auto-opens a LOW ModerationCase.

**강제 취소와 파트너 확정 동시 실행**: Partner clicks 확정 at the same moment as admin cancel. Both target the same Event row; Postgres serializes them. Whichever gets the row lock first wins; the finalize path re-checks `status='FINALIZING'` after acquiring and aborts with 409. No confirmed list is ever produced for a canceled event.

**강제 마감 후 입금 만료 스윕이 확정 리스트를 흔든다**: If ranking is finalized before all deposit windows close, a late deposit would change the outcome. Defense: finalization is scheduled at max(holdExpiresAt) across pending holds (BR-E2), the sweeper marks holds expired inside a transaction, and finalization takes a `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on the event before snapshotting.

**입금 만료 스윕 지연으로 인한 과다 확정 (INSTANT)**: A cron skip means expired holds keep occupying slots, then a burst of reclaims lets claimedCount exceed capacity. Per the product decision this is ACCEPTED. Admin tooling shows the overshoot badge and the partner trims on the final-list screen. Do not add reconciliation locking.

**재입찰 롤백 경합**: A user raises their bid at deadline-1s; the shortfall window extends past the deadline; the sweeper rolls the amount back to the previously funded amount while the partner is viewing the ranked list. Defense: the partner's list view is snapshot-based (rankingSnapshot taken at finalization), and any pre-finalization view is labeled '잠정 순위 — 마감 후 확정됩니다'. Admin sees both the live and snapshot views side by side.

**롤백으로 lastBidAt이 유리해지는 게이밍**: If a rollback restored the *raise* timestamp, a user could raise-then-let-it-expire to refresh their tie-break clock. Rule the admin console must be able to verify: on rollback, BOTH amount AND lastBidAt revert to the previously funded bid's values. The bid history table makes this auditable; the admin bid-history view is the forensic tool.

**취소 후 재신청으로 시계 초기화**: Blocked in the Event context, but admins must be able to detect attempts. The admin applicant view shows cancel→reapply pairs on the same event for the same account with a warning badge, feeding COMPETITION_MANIPULATION cases.

**다중 계정 (부계정) 입찰**: Same person, multiple Google accounts, to occupy several ranked slots. Admin-side signals: same contactPhone, same device fingerprint hash, same IP /24 within a short window, near-identical bid patterns. Surface as a 'suspicious cluster' panel on the event admin page. Do NOT auto-suspend — false positives on shared networks (회사, 학교) are common. Human decision, audited.

**KST 자정 경계**: A broadcast sent at 23:59:59 KST and its retry at 00:00:01 KST fall in different daily buckets, silently doubling the daily quota. Defense: the daily counter key is computed once at compose time from the *campaign's* createdAt KST date, and the rate-limit check uses that frozen key.

**KST vs UTC 통계 불일치**: Naive `date_trunc('day', createdAt)` yields UTC days, shifting every Korean metric by 9 hours and making '어제 신규 가입' wrong. Every rollup uses `(createdAt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date`. There is no DST in Korea, so no ambiguous/skipped local times — but the code must still never use the instance's TZ env var.

**예약 발송 시각의 서머타임 착시**: Admin schedules '내일 오전 10시'. Stored as UTC. If the console ever runs with a non-KST browser locale, the conversion silently shifts. Defense: the API accepts `{ scheduledAtLocal: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', timeZone: 'Asia/Seoul' }` — never a bare ISO string from the browser — and echoes the resolved KST + UTC pair back for confirmation.
**크론 중복 실행 / 겹침**: Vercel can invoke overlapping ticks under load. Advisory lock + `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` batches + per-recipient unique constraints make every worker safely re-entrant.

**크론 미실행 (Vercel 장애)**: Holds never expire, suspensions never lift, scheduled broadcasts never fire. Defense: lazy-on-read for holds and suspensions; for broadcasts, a dashboard card shows 'SCHEDULED and overdue by > 10 min' with a manual 'now send' button. Add a heartbeat row (`cron:<name>.lastRunAt`) and alert when stale > 15 min.

**발송 워커 타임아웃 중 중복 발송**: The worker times out after sending a Resend batch but before persisting statuses. Next tick re-reads those recipients as QUEUED and resends. Mitigation: persist status transitions BEFORE the Resend call (optimistic SENDING) and reconcile via the webhook; a duplicate email is far less harmful than a lost one, but the in-app 쪽지 is created with an upsert on (campaignId, accountId) so the user never sees two.

**Resend 부분 실패**: A 100-recipient batch returns 207-ish partial success. Each recipient's status is set individually from the response; unmapped entries stay QUEUED with attemptCount+1 and are retried up to 3 times with backoff, then FAILED. Campaign lands in PARTIALLY_FAILED, never silently SENT.

**바운스 폭풍**: A bad segment produces thousands of hard bounces and torches the sending-domain reputation. Defense: a circuit breaker — if bounceRate within a campaign exceeds 10% after the first 500 sends, the worker pauses the campaign (status stays SENDING, lockedUntil far future) and raises a CRITICAL alert.

**대량 발송 도중 계정 탈퇴**: The recipient withdrew after the snapshot. Pre-send check per recipient: if Account.status = WITHDRAWN or an ACTIVE FULL_LOGIN suspension exists, mark SUPPRESSED with the reason instead of sending.

**공지 본문을 통한 입찰 정보 유출**: A partner writes '현재 1등은 32만원입니다, 더 올리세요' to all applicants of an OPEN bid event. This is the single worst leak in the product. Defenses stack: template-variable whitelist (BR-B4), keyword+amount regex flag forcing approval (BR-B5), send-rate limits, and a post-hoc audit of all partner EVENT-scope broadcasts sent while OPEN. Confirmed cases → COMPETITION_MANIPULATION, RESET_FINAL_LIST, and partner suspension.

**세그먼트 필터를 통한 유출**: A partner sends to segment EVENT_APPLICANTS_BY_STATUS with a filter that only matches top bidders; the mere receipt of the message reveals rank. Defense: partners may only use segments {EVENT_APPLICANTS(all), EVENT_CONFIRMED, EVENT_NOT_SELECTED}, and the latter two are unavailable until event.status = FINALIZED. Amount-range or rank-range segments are ADMIN-only and blocked entirely while the event is OPEN.

**미리보기를 통한 유출**: The recipient-count preview on a filtered segment is itself an oracle — a partner could binary-search the cutoff by counting how many applicants exceed a threshold. Defense: partners never get a count for amount-conditioned filters (those filters don't exist for them), and preview counts below 5 are rendered as '5명 미만' for all filtered segments.

**관리자 목록 API를 통한 유출**: A misconfigured route returns full applicant amounts to a USER token. Defense: every /admin route is behind a global AdminGuard, admin DTOs live in a separate `packages/shared/src/admin` namespace that the public web bundle does not import, and a CI check fails the build if a public route handler returns a type from that namespace.

**경쟁률 자체가 유출 채널**: With capacity 1 and 2 applicants, the ratio plus a cancellation timing can reveal a specific person's action. Accept for MVP, but the admin visibility settings should let ops suppress the ratio below a minimum applicant count (MIN_APPLICANTS_FOR_RATIO, default 3 → show '신청 접수중').

**감사 로그 위변조**: An attacker with DB access edits a row to hide a force-cancel. Hash chain + weekly verification + no UPDATE/DELETE grant. A gap or mismatch is itself the alert; we cannot prevent a DB-superuser rewrite, and the design should not pretend otherwise (see open questions re: WORM export).

**감사 로그가 병목이 됨**: The single-chain advisory lock serializes writes. At admin volumes (< 10/s) this is fine, but a bulk operation (dismiss 200 cases) would take 200 lock round-trips. Defense: bulk operations write ONE audit row with an array payload, not N rows.

**대량 작업 부분 실패**: bulk-dismiss of 200 cases fails at #137. Defense: chunk into transactions of 50, return `{ succeeded: [...], failed: [{id, reason}] }` with HTTP 207-style semantics, and make the whole call idempotent so the console can retry safely.

**카테고리 병합 중 이벤트 생성**: A partner publishes an event referencing the source category mid-merge. Defense: merge marks the source inactive FIRST (so new authoring rejects it), then repoints existing rows in batches, then re-scans once for stragglers.
**사용 중인 카테고리 삭제 시도**: Blocked by BR-D1. usageCount is a nightly denormalization and can be stale, so the merge/deactivate path also does a live `EXISTS` check inside the transaction.

**마지막 슈퍼관리자 자가 비활성화**: Blocked by BR-A2/BR-A3, with the count check inside the transaction holding row locks — two admins simultaneously deactivating the two remaining super admins must not both succeed.

**운영자 계정 탈취**: Google account compromise gives full platform control. Mitigations in scope: 15-minute re-auth for dangerous actions, IP/UA change detection raising a notification to all SUPER_ADMINs, mandatory reason memos (a hurried attacker leaves a bad trail), and rate limits on destructive endpoints (max 10 force-cancels per hour per admin, exceeding requires SUPER_ADMIN).

**대행 보기(임퍼소네이션) 남용**: An admin acts as a partner to edit a final list. Defense in MVP: IMPERSONATION_ENABLED=false; when enabled, the token carries readOnly=true enforced by a global guard that rejects all non-GET methods, TTL 15 min, every request tagged with impersonatedAccountId in the audit log, and a persistent banner in the console.

**제재 중인 파트너의 진행중 이벤트**: Users already applied and possibly paid deposits. Never silently cancel (BR-S3). If ultimately canceled, all applicants are notified with a neutral reason (the partner's misconduct is not disclosed — defamation risk) and refund intents are created.

**제재 해제 후 이벤트 자동 복구 여부**: Lifting a suspension does NOT auto-restore SUSPENDED events (the deadline may have passed, the venue may be gone). Restoration is an explicit, separately audited action, and is refused if deadlineAt <= now() without an extension.

**탈퇴 후 재가입으로 제재 회피**: Google sub is stable, so a re-login to the same Google account re-links. Different Google account = new identity. Mitigation signals only: phone hash and BRN hash carry across (for partners, BRN is the strong key). Document that user-side evasion is not fully solvable without 본인인증, and put that in open questions.

**개인정보 파기 요청과 감사 로그 보존 충돌**: 개인정보보호법 requires deletion; audit integrity requires retention. Resolution: anonymize pseudonymizes the Account and replaces PII in audit beforeJson/afterJson with '[REDACTED]', while preserving accountId, action, timestamps, and the hash chain (the hash covers the redacted canonical form going forward, with a documented `redactedAt` marker so verification accounts for it).

**신고 대상이 신고 접수 전에 삭제됨**: evidenceSnapshot was captured at report time, so the case remains reviewable; the case transitions to AUTO_CLOSED with the snapshot retained for the standard retention period.

**대시보드 쿼리가 프로덕션을 죽임**: An admin filters all events with no date bound. Defense: every admin list endpoint enforces a max page size (100), keyset pagination, a mandatory or defaulted date window (last 90 days) on high-cardinality tables, and a statement_timeout of 5s on the admin DB role.

**SSE 연결이 서버리스에서 끊김**: Vercel functions have execution limits; a long-lived SSE stream will be cut. Defense: the stream self-terminates at 50s with a `retry: 3000` directive so EventSource reconnects cleanly, and the client falls back to 10s polling after two failed reconnects. Never assume a persistent connection.

**수수료 정책 소급 적용 사고**: An admin edits a live policy to fix a typo and silently changes settlement for hundreds of past events. Defense: PlatformFeePolicy rows are effectively immutable — 'editing' means ending the current row and creating a new one; plus feePolicySnapshot on both Event and SettlementRecord.

**정산 금액 반올림 불일치**: Percent-of-amount on odd KRW values produces off-by-one totals between the per-event and aggregate views. Defense: compute per-event with a single floor-to-won helper and derive aggregates by summing the per-event integers — never by applying the percentage to the aggregate.

**설정 캐시 불일치**: An admin flips DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED but warm serverless instances keep the old value for up to 60s, so two concurrent applications get different behavior. Defense: for behavior-changing flags, read through with a 5s TTL and include the settings `revision` in the response of any admin write so the console can show '적용까지 최대 5초'. Truly critical flags (DEPOSIT_HOLD_ENABLED) are read uncached inside the application transaction.

**공휴일 SLA 오계산**: '1 영업일' silently ignores 설날/추석 (lunar, shifting yearly). Defense: a seeded KoreanHoliday table maintained yearly; if the table has no rows for the current year, SLA badges are suppressed rather than shown wrong, and a dashboard warning appears in December.

**Resend 웹훅 위조**: An attacker posts fake bounce events to suppress a competitor's email. Defense: verify the svix signature, reject on failure, dedupe by Resend event id, and never let a webhook create or delete rows — only transition existing recipient statuses.

**신고 폭탄으로 경쟁 파트너 마비**: 20 sockpuppets file FRAUD_SCAM on a rival's event, triggering auto-hide (BR-M3). Defense: auto-hide requires either (a) a reporter with a clean 90-day history and account age > 7 days, or (b) 3+ independent reporters. Reports from accounts younger than 24h never trigger auto-hide, only queue placement.

**감사 로그의 법적 증거력 수준**: 해시 체인은 애플리케이션 레벨 변조를 탐지하지만 DB 슈퍼유저 변조는 막지 못합니다. 외부 WORM 스토리지(예: 일 1회 Vercel Blob에 append-only 내보내기 + 해시 공증)까지 필요한 수준인지, 아니면 내부 감사용으로 충분한지 결정이 필요합니다.
**감사 로그 보존 기간**: 3년을 가정했습니다. 전자상거래법상 거래기록 5년, 개인정보보호법상 최소수집 원칙이 상충합니다. 법무 검토 후 확정 필요.
**대행 보기(임퍼소네이션) 최종 정책**: MVP는 비활성 + 활성화 시 읽기 전용입니다. CS 대응 과정에서 '파트너 대신 이벤트를 수정해 달라'는 요청이 반드시 들어옵니다. 쓰기 가능한 대행을 허용할지, 허용한다면 파트너의 사전 동의 토큰을 받는 구조로 갈지 결정이 필요합니다.
**공지 발송의 광고성/정보성 분류 책임**: 정보통신망법상 광고성 정보 오분류는 과태료 대상입니다. 분류를 운영자 판단에 맡길지, 아니면 SYSTEM 트리거 기반 발송만 정보성으로 고정하고 사람이 작성한 모든 공지를 광고성으로 취급(야간 발송 금지 + 수신동의 필수)할지. 후자가 안전하지만 운영 편의성이 떨어집니다.
**파트너 공지 발송 권한의 존폐**: 정보 유출 방어 장치를 여러 겹 넣었지만, 진행 중 이벤트에 대한 파트너 자유 서술 발송은 근본적으로 위험합니다. MVP에서는 파트너 공지를 사전 정의된 템플릿 3~5종(예: 일정 안내, 준비물 안내, 감사 인사)으로만 제한하는 안을 검토하시겠습니까?
**경쟁률 최소 노출 기준**: 신청자 3명 미만일 때 경쟁률을 숨기는 MIN_APPLICANTS_FOR_RATIO 기본값 3이 적절한지, 아니면 소규모 이벤트(정원 2~4명)가 주력이라 경쟁률을 항상 보여줘야 하는지 제품 판단이 필요합니다.
**지역 마스터 데이터의 깊이**: 시/도 + 시/군/구 2단계로 설계했습니다. '강남 신사동' 수준의 동 단위 검색 수요가 있다면 3단계로 확장해야 하고, 이는 검색 인덱스와 필터 UI에 영향을 줍니다.
**운영자 알림 채널**: CRITICAL 이벤트(감사 체인 불일치, 바운스 폭풍, 크론 정지) 발생 시 어디로 알릴지 — 이메일만인지, Slack webhook을 추가할지. Slack이면 PlatformSetting에 webhook URL을 두고 OpsAlert 엔티티를 하나 더 추가하겠습니다.
**공휴일 테이블 유지 주체**: 음력 공휴일 때문에 매년 갱신이 필요합니다. 수동 시드 마이그레이션으로 갈지, 공공데이터포털 특일정보 API를 연 1회 크론으로 당겨올지 결정이 필요합니다.
